payload.name: SearchProfileKindsForMembershipQueries
payload.description: When a question asks what classes, courses, groups, workshops, or organizations a person has joined, attended, or participates in, include profile and state memory kinds, not only event/plan.
content: When answering what classes, courses, groups, workshops, or memberships a person has joined/attends/participates in, do not restrict memory_kinds to event and plan; also search profile, state, and preference kinds because ongoing affiliations are often stored there.

Run at least one complementary search using membership phrasing such as 'is a member of', 'joined', 'participates in', or 'signed up for' without a restrictive memory-kind filter, then aggregate all named classes/groups from every retrieved memory before answering.

solves: The diagnosed failure: the agent answered a question about joined classes/groups using only event/plan memory kinds and missed a profile memory recording an ongoing group membership. Sustained memberships, affiliations, and enrolled courses are frequently stored as profile/state facts rather than one-off events, so memory-kind restrictions hide them. This rule applies to any future question asking what classes, courses, groups, workshops, or organizations a person has joined, attended, or participates in.
